title: Post-deploy source retirement
summary: Replacing a case leaves the item's old post_deploy row live until rematerialize retires it: superseded by its one successor, or waived when removed. Plain `yoke qa plan materialize` and gates retain the existing item snapshot unchanged; only explicit rematerialize applies plan edits, preserving operator waivers and clearing system waivers. Superseding a run copy never retires its item source; the receipt's next_admission_notice names that source for a direct copy and, for a plan copy, the member's plan row with the plan correction and rematerialize that retire it.
